values.headline: Ex-OWWA chief, 10 others face graft raps
values.subheadline: FORMER Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA) Administrator Arnell Ignacio, along with two former deputy administrators and several others, will face graft and corruption charges over a P1.4-billion land transaction that allegedly bypassed the OWWA Board of Trustees, the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) said Tuesday.

values.headline: Gov't set to roll out P20/k rice for 15m families
values.subheadline: Tiu-Laurel said the Department of Ag-riculture will buy palay directly from farmers, with 20 percent of stocks sold at P20 per kilo. The rest will be sold at P38 to P42 per kilo to help fund the subsidy.
